market.basis: heading names the planning region (a county equivalent); legacy-county composition is an approximation

ct.basis_legacy: approximation from legacy counties; a town-level crosswalk is needed for exactness
ct.fit_legacy: approximate: Northeastern Connecticut corresponds closely to Windham County, with edge differences
ct.fit_planning: exact: heading names Northeastern, the Northeastern Connecticut Planning Region

market.reason: Planning region is exact; Windham County is a close but not exact legacy match.
